project_type: React 19 SPA with Firebase Firestore backend, deployed to GitHub Pages
test_framework: None configured - no test files exist in the project
test_command: No test command configured - use build as primary verification
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` to verify no syntax errors or import issues. Manual Firestore testing not possible in sandbox.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Firestore emulator available. Firebase config requires environment variables not present in sandbox. Verification limited to build success and AST validation.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow existing code style: ES modules, named exports for services, default exports for components, Firestore SDK v9 modular API.
key_patterns: Services use firebase/firestore modular API (getDoc, getDocs, etc). Components are functional with hooks. productService.js contains CRUD operations plus rebuildCatalogSnapshot(). normalizeProduct() strips to {id, sr, productName, wPrice, rPrice, priceType, material}. Catalog doc at 'catalog/current' has {products: [...], updatedAt: timestamp}. Audit logs via logAuditEvent({action, before, after}). Image/note services query by sr field.
directory_structure: src/services/ - Firebase service modules; src/pages/ - top-level page components (HomePage, AdminPage); src/components/ - reusable UI components; src/utils/ - helper utilities (CSV, search, cloudinary); src/constants/ - config
